# ShopLite - Account Help and Support
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

To reset a forgotten password, select Forgot password on the ShopLite sign-in screen and enter the email associated with the account. Use the link in the reset email. If the message does not appear, check spam or junk folders. The assistant cannot generate reset links or verify that a reset email was sent.

Support is available through the Help section in the customer's account, Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 America/New_York time, excluding public holidays. The expected first response is within 2 business days; this is not a guarantee of resolution.

A customer may provide an order number to the real support team for order-related inquiries. The demo assistant has no access to customer accounts, identity records, tickets, or order databases. It cannot change an email address, reset a password, create a support ticket, or take actions on a customer's behalf.

Do not request passwords, full card details, security codes, or one-time authentication codes. No real customer data should be added to this demonstration dataset.

# ShopLite - Cancellations and Address Changes
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

An order may be canceled from the Orders section of the customer's account within 60 minutes after placement, provided warehouse processing has not begun. Both conditions must hold. A request made 90 minutes after placement is outside the self-service cancellation window, even if the order has not yet shipped.

The delivery address can be changed during that same 60-minute window only while warehouse processing has not begun. After the window closes or warehouse processing begins, support may review a request, but cancellation or an address change is not guaranteed.

Customers should not create a second order on the assumption that the first has been canceled. If cancellation is not possible, the delivered product may be eligible under the Returns Policy. Eligibility depends on the product's condition and the time since delivery.

The assistant cannot access order status, cancel an order, change an address, or confirm that processing has begun. It can only explain these rules.

# ShopLite - Damaged Items Policy
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

When an item arrives damaged, the customer must report the arrival damage within 7 calendar days after delivery. Submit the claim through the Help section of the ShopLite account and provide the order number, a photo of the damaged product, and a photo of the shipping packaging. Keep the item and packaging until support gives instructions.

Opening packaging to discover or document arrival damage does not make the claim ineligible. For example, an item delivered 3 days ago that was damaged on arrival can be reported even after its packaging was opened. Damage caused by the customer after delivery does not qualify as arrival damage.

For an approved arrival-damage claim, the customer may choose a replacement when available or a full refund including the original shipping charge. ShopLite supplies a prepaid return label if it requires the damaged product to be returned. Do not promise a replacement is in stock.

The assistant cannot assess photographs, approve a claim, issue a label, or initiate a refund. It only explains the policy and submission process.

# ShopLite - Payments and Discounts
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

ShopLite accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. It does not offer cash on delivery, cryptocurrency payments, or installment plans under this demo policy. All displayed amounts in this knowledge base are in US dollars.

Only one promotional discount code may be used per order. Discount codes cannot be combined with each other. A code must be entered at checkout before payment; this policy does not promise that a code can be applied retroactively. Product-specific exclusions may be shown with the promotion.

A payment failure does not necessarily mean the customer's bank account lacks funds. Customers should check their payment details or contact their payment provider. The assistant cannot see declined-payment reasons, payment credentials, available balances, or bank transactions.

No dates or discount amounts for future sales are published in these documents. The assistant must not invent upcoming promotions. Never ask a customer for a full card number, security code, password, or one-time authentication code.

# ShopLite - Refunds Policy
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

For approved returns, ShopLite inspects the returned item after it reaches the warehouse. Within 5 business days after a successful inspection, ShopLite issues a refund to the original payment method. The bank or payment provider may then take an additional 3 to 7 business days to display it. These are separate stages; do not promise that money will appear within 5 days of posting the return.

For a change-of-mind return, the original outbound shipping charge is not refunded and return shipping is paid by the customer. For an approved arrival-damage claim, the remedy and shipping costs follow the Damaged Items Policy.

The assistant can explain the general refund process but cannot see whether a specific return was received, inspected, approved, or refunded. It cannot issue a refund. For a transaction-specific update, the customer must contact support through the account's Help section.

# ShopLite - Returns Policy
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

Customers may request a change-of-mind return within 30 calendar days after delivery. The delivery date, not the order date, starts this window. Products must be unused, in their original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. An unopened pair of headphones delivered 20 days ago is eligible if these conditions are met.

Opened personal-care products, downloaded digital products, and personalized items are not eligible for change-of-mind returns. Opened headphones that have been used and are not faulty are also not eligible. A change-of-mind request made 45 days after delivery is outside the return window.

Start a return from the Returns section of your ShopLite account. Approval is required before sending an item. For an approved change-of-mind return, the customer pays return shipping. Refund timing is described in the Refunds Policy.

An item that arrived damaged follows the separate Damaged Items Policy, even if its packaging has been opened. Do not apply the unused-item condition to an arrival-damage claim. The assistant cannot approve a return or access a customer's order.

# ShopLite - Shipping Policy
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

ShopLite ships only within the contiguous United States. International shipping and delivery to Alaska or Hawaii are not available in this demo policy.

Standard shipping costs USD 5 for a merchandise subtotal below USD 50. Standard shipping is free when the merchandise subtotal is at least USD 50 after discounts and before tax. Express shipping costs USD 12 regardless of order value. Express shipping is not included in the free-standard-shipping offer.

Orders normally take 1 to 2 business days to process before dispatch. After dispatch, standard delivery normally takes 3 to 5 business days, while express delivery normally takes 1 to 2 business days. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays.

A tracking link is emailed after dispatch. The assistant has no access to live tracking or order records and cannot locate an individual package, even when given an order number. Customers should use their tracking link or contact support.

# ShopLite - Product Warranty
Policy version: demo-v1. Fictional policies for an educational demo, not a real store.

ShopLite electronic products include a limited 12-month warranty beginning on the delivery date. It covers manufacturing defects that appear during normal use. Proof of purchase is required. An electronic product that develops a manufacturing defect 6 months after delivery may qualify if the other conditions are met.

The warranty excludes accidental damage, liquid damage, misuse, unauthorized repairs, and ordinary cosmetic wear. It does not extend the 30-day change-of-mind return window. Arrival damage should instead be reported under the separate Damaged Items Policy.

Submit a warranty request through the account's Help section with the order number, a description of the defect, and the product serial number. After assessment and approval, ShopLite may repair or replace the product. Do not promise an automatic cash refund or guarantee claim approval.

The assistant cannot inspect a product, determine the cause of a fault, look up warranty registration, or approve a warranty claim.
